title: Motorhome & RV Windshield Thermal Cover 211 × 171 cm – Exterior and Blackout
descriptionHtml:
The windshield is fogged up on the inside every morning

The moisture from the night settles on the inside of the windshield, and interior curtains only trap it between the glass and the fabric. In summer it's the opposite: the sun is beating down and the cabin is thirty degrees Celsius before breakfast is done. And at a rest stop you know everyone walking by can see straight in.

On the outside of the glass – where the cold and the sun are actually stopped

The cover is stretched on the outside over the windshield and both side windows, so the glass never gets a chance to go cold from the inside. At the same time it blacks out the whole front end: no one can see in, and the morning sun doesn't wake you at four. Two minutes of work on the outside instead of wiping away condensation every day.

Features

  • Condensation gets no hold on the inside of the glass – the cover sits outside the glass, not inside
  • The cabin doesn't hit thirty degrees from the morning sun – dense material that stops the heat before it gets in
  • No one can see in at the rest stop – blackout all the way across the front end
  • Covers the windshield and both side windows – 211 cm wide, 171 cm across the middle, 90 cm side flaps
  • Fastens without opening the doors – the flaps are clamped in the door frame and hold in wind

Change of mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
